divergence_justification: Phenylephrine attempt 0002 faithfully maps the exact ICU MedicationAdministration code, preserves all 193,260 source-event rows and multiplicity, and uses every available FHIR path. ICU ETL irreversibly casts start/end times through TIMESTAMPTZ (mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:8-9,61-69) and writes amount into six-decimal dosage.dose.value (:12,85-90), while omitting linkorderid and patientweight (:7-23,38-100). Rate unit survives in dosage.rateQuantity.unit (:91-98), so the one uncomputable mcg/min rate is correctly NULL rather than estimated. The reported residual conflicts are amplified by unkeyed stay-only pairing, not evidence of another mapping defect. These losses are intrinsic and ancillary: they do not change row inclusion, grain, grouping, carry-forward, or other clinically meaningful outputs.
